# nsresolver_zone (Data Source)

Looks up a zone in your NSResolver account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nsresolver_zone" "example" {
  name = "example.com"
}

output "example_status" {
  value = data.nsresolver_zone.example.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The domain, e.g. `example.com`.

### Read-Only

- `default_ttl` (Number) TTL used for records created without one, in seconds.
- `expire` (Number) SOA expire, in seconds.
- `id` (String) The zone name.
- `negative_answer` (Number) SOA negative-answer TTL, in seconds.
- `published` (Boolean) Whether NSResolver's nameservers serve the latest change.
- `record_count` (Number) Number of records in the zone.
- `refresh` (Number) SOA refresh, in seconds.
- `retry` (Number) SOA retry, in seconds.
- `serial` (Number) The zone's SOA serial.
- `status` (String) `live`, `pending` or `on hold`.
